scoring_justification: The Zeeman reference is taken from the paper’s published model lines (Fig. 10); a live recompute of the 20×20 U′ Hamiltonian would be overly fragile to implement correctly in the checker and is not necessary for verifying the predicted components.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference Zeeman components at B=3.5 T along [001] derived from the paper’s fitted model (Fig. 10).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 10 (theoretical fit lines) and Fig. 14.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted approximate energy values from the figure’s model curves for the cold transitions a, b, c of the L line and the cold π‑polarized d component of the L′ line.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual predicted values that a correct solver implementing the Hamiltonian and fitting should reproduce; they are not random and are consistent with the paper’s discussion.

outputs.description: Fitted model parameters: spin–orbit γ, exchange D, Jahn–Teller phonon energy ħω_E, coupling strength V/α, all in cm⁻¹.
Predicted Zeeman components for the L (E′) and L′ (U′) transitions at B = 3.5 T along [001]; energies relative to the zero‑field L line.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare the submitted hparams.json to the paper‑reported values within tolerance and will recompute the Zeeman splitting from the submitted parameters to verify consistency with the submitted zeeman_splitting.json.
